_source: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25, 'Wireless energy' (the user's design of 19:25 and 19:30): one global network, stored in Wireless Energy Towers whose capacitor cells set its size and its voltage; wireless energy and dynamo hatches at 2, 4, 16 and 64 A and wireless energy and dynamo covers, LV to IV; 5% lost on the way in. Capacities follow GTM 7.5.3's Power Substation (a cell holds six of its tier's batteries: PowerSubstationMachine / BatteryBlock.BatteryPartType, EV = 6 lapotron crystals); here six of the tier's reference battery (GTItems: LV and MV and HV lithium, EV small vanadium, IV medium vanadium).
_how_it_is_used: Read by startup_scripts/grindless/lv/wireless_energy.js (global.grindless.wireless.table): the cell blocks, the hatches, the covers and the tower; by server_scripts/grindless/lv/wireless_energy.js: the settlement, the readout and every recipe; by the smoke test tools/test/overlay/kubejs/server_scripts/gg_test_wireless_energy.js. Nothing here is repeated in code.

tiers[]: one row per voltage tier (1 = LV ... 5 = IV). cell = the capacitor cell block of that tier and capacity its EU (6 x reference battery); the cell recipe takes 6 of the tier's batteries (any battery of the tag), a frame, plates and circuits. emitter / sensor = what the wireless blocks of that tier take (EV takes HV ones: GTM's EV emitter and sensor need a quantum eye, radon, IV). link = the tier's 'ender' part. plate / frame = the tier's hull metal. wire = the tier's cable metal (GTM: tin, copper, gold, aluminium, platinum): the 4, 16 and 64 A hatches add its quadruple, octal and hex wires, GTM's way (energy_input_hatch_4a / 16a).

hatchAmps: the amperages of the wireless energy and dynamo hatches; coverAmps: the covers'. settleTicks: the settlement period (GTM 7.5.3's input hatch holds 16 ticks of its full rate, EnergyHatchPartMachine: V x 16 x A; every 10 ticks leaves 6 ticks to spare). loss: what reaches the network of every EU that goes in (19/20).

The network's tier is the lowest tier among the cells of every formed tower (an empty cell slot holds the tower's casing and counts for nothing); hatches and covers above it get nothing. Energy going in is not tier-limited.
